run_viewer_server: run the 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer server with viser on a configured host and port
scan_avail_iters: scan a model path directory and return all available training iteration checkpoint paths
read_cameras_json: read a cameras JSON file and return a list of Camera objects from train or root entries
RenderViewer_init: initialize a RenderViewer instance with a Hydra config and Viser server to load Gaussian Splatting models
RenderViewer_viewer_render_fn: render a Gaussian Splatting scene from a camera state and return an RGB, depth, or normal image
